name: GS Variation Swatches for WooCommerce
author: GS Plugins

sections.description:
GS Variation Swatches for WooCommerce turns the dropdowns on your variable products into swatches shoppers can see and tap: color chips for Color, photos for patterns and materials, buttons for sizes, and radio lists for plans or bundles. Set a color or image once for each attribute option, and every product that uses it shows swatches.

A setup wizard gets your first swatches working in a few minutes, and the Look & feel screen shows every change in a live preview before you save.

👉 Live demo · Documentation · Pro features

Who it’s for

  • Clothing and shoe stores: colors and sizes shoppers can see at a glance.
  • Furniture, fabric and home stores: photo swatches for materials, finishes and patterns.
  • Stores with many variations: buttons and radio lists that are faster than long dropdowns.
  • Anyone tired of “Choose an option”: shoppers see every option before they pick.

Why store owners choose GS Variation Swatches

  • Quick to set up: a setup wizard fills in colors from your option names and can create a sample product.
  • See it before you save: pick a style preset, then adjust colors and sizes with a live preview.
  • Works with your store: WooCommerce order storage (HPOS), the Cart and Checkout blocks, and theme quick views.
  • Accessible: screen readers hear which swatch is selected.

Free features

Swatch types

  • Color swatches in 4 styles, round or square.
  • Image swatches in 3 styles, round or square.
  • Button / label swatches in 3 styles, round or square.
  • Radio swatches: classic list, stacked buttons or inline buttons, one per line or side by side.
  • A color or image for each option under Products > Attributes.
  • Turn plain dropdown attributes into buttons.

Look & feel

  • One-click style presets with a live preview.
  • Colors for the check mark, cross, background, border, text and the picked and disabled states.
  • Swatch width, height and font size.
  • Tooltips on hover, with their own colors.

Product page

  • Attribute name below, above or to the left of the swatches.
  • Show the picked value next to the name (“Color: Green”) with your own separator.
  • Clear a swatch by clicking it again.
  • Image size for image swatches.
  • Works in product quick views (Flatsome and similar themes).

Shop and catalog

  • A swatch preview of one attribute on product cards; picking a swatch swaps the card image.
  • Plugin product cards and catalog page styling (title, sorting, pagination).

Setup and tools

  • Setup wizard and a setup checklist.
  • Optional deletion of all plugin data on uninstall.
  • Translation ready.

Pro features

GS Variation Swatches Pro adds:

  • Full swatches on shop cards: every attribute, with add to cart without opening the product.
  • One-click card looks and more card options: layout, frame, corners, image area, title, button and price color.
  • Long option lists: a maximum per attribute, with a “+N more” link or a ‹ › slider.
  • Out-of-stock handling: disable sold-out options and show them crossed out, faded or hidden.
  • Categories that skip swatches and keep their dropdowns.
  • Choose which attributes and terms show, and in which order.
  • Extra swatch styles: photo + name pill, searchable dropdown and two-color swatches.
  • A larger image preview on hover and shareable links for the picked variation.
  • Per-product swatch settings.
  • Shortcode builder with a live preview, a Gutenberg block and an Elementor widget.
  • Priority email support.

Plans start at $49 per year, with a 7-day money-back guarantee. Compare Pro plans.

How it works

  1. Go to Products > Attributes, then create or edit an attribute such as Color or Size and set its Type to Color, Image, Button or Radio.
  2. Click Configure terms and pick a color or upload an image for each option.
  3. Add the attribute to a variable product, create the variations and save. The product page now shows swatches.
  4. Go to Woo Swatches > Settings to pick a look, and turn on shop swatches under Shop & Catalog if you want them on product cards.

Or open Woo Swatches > Setup Wizard, which does most of this for you.

Support

Free users get help in the WordPress.org support forum. Pro users get priority email support through our help desk. We reply as soon as we can, excluding holidays.

More plugins from GS Plugins

  • GS Logo Slider: client, partner and sponsor logos in sliders, carousels, tickers and grids.
  • Solid Testimonials: customer reviews and quotes in sliders, grids and masonry layouts.
  • GS Team Members: team pages and staff directories with profiles and social links.
  • GS Portfolio: show your work in grid, slider, list and filterable layouts.
  • GS Projects Showcase: case studies with client, dates, value and project links.
  • GS Books Showcase: books with covers, ISBN and publication details in a grid or slider.
  • GS Coaches: coach and trainer profiles with skills and certifications.
  • GS Posts Grid: blog posts in 50+ grid, list and slider styles.
  • GS Product Slider for WooCommerce: product sliders and carousels for your shop.
  • GS Brands for WooCommerce: brand logos on product and shop pages, plus brand sliders.
  • GS Pinterest Portfolio: embed Pinterest pins and boards.
  • GS YouTube Gallery: YouTube videos, playlists and channels in galleries.
  • PowerUp: redirects, restrictions and admin tools for WordPress.

External services

GS Variation Swatches connects to these outside services. Nothing is sent until the step described happens.

Appsero (api.appsero.com)
Used for optional usage statistics and the deactivation survey. Nothing is sent unless an administrator clicks Allow on the “help make Variation Swatches even more awesome” notice; after that the site URL, site name, administrator name and email, WordPress, PHP and server versions, number of users, active and inactive plugins, the plugin version and the server IP address are sent, and again about once a week. Without Allow, only the answers to the optional deactivation survey are sent (with the site URL and technical details, not your email, name or IP address). Appsero privacy policy

Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com, fonts.gstatic.com)
The plugin’s Help, GS Plugins Pro and GS Plugins Lite admin pages load the DM Sans font from Google Fonts. Only an administrator viewing those pages makes the request, which sends their IP address and browser details to Google, as any web font request does. Google Fonts privacy FAQ · Google privacy policy

CDN Fonts (fonts.cdnfonts.com)
The same three admin pages load the Gotham font from CDN Fonts. Only an administrator viewing those pages makes the request, which sends their IP address and browser details. CDN Fonts (terms and privacy policy linked from their site)

GS Plugins (gsplugins.com)
The GS Plugins Pro admin page downloads the list of GS Plugins products from gsplugins.com to show them, and keeps it for a few days. The request carries the site’s address and WordPress version, which WordPress adds to every outgoing request, and the server’s IP address. GS Plugins privacy policy

The storefront makes no outside requests: swatches, fonts and scripts load from your own site.

Development source

Every minified file in this plugin is built from the readable source included in the download:

  • dev/ holds the source of the admin dashboard (Vue), the Welcome page, and the front-end scripts and styles.
  • includes/gs-common-pages/assets/ holds the source of the Help, GS Plugins Pro and GS Plugins Lite page styles next to their .min.css file.
  • webpack.mix.js and package.json hold the build setup.

To rebuild: run npm install, then npm run production. Third-party libraries in assets/libs/ (Tippy.js, Font Awesome and a prefixed Bootstrap grid) are the releases from their projects.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New and search for GS Variation Swatches.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. A Woo Swatches menu appears in your dashboard, and the setup wizard opens on a new store.

By uploading the zip file

  1. Download gs-woo-variation-swatches.zip.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, choose the file and click Install Now.
  3. Activate the plugin.

By FTP

  1. Upload the gs-woo-variation-swatches folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from Plugins in your dashboard.

See the setup guide for screenshots of each step.
sections.faq:
How do I turn a dropdown into swatches?

Go to Products > Attributes, set the attribute’s Type to Color, Image, Button or Radio (not Select), then click Configure terms and pick a color or image for each option. Every variable product that uses the attribute shows swatches. The setup wizard under Woo Swatches > Setup Wizard can do this for you.

I changed the settings, but the product page still shows dropdowns. Why?

Settings only change how swatches look. A dropdown becomes swatches once its attribute type is Color, Image, Button or Radio. To turn every remaining dropdown into buttons, switch on Turn dropdowns into buttons under Woo Swatches > Settings. If you use a caching plugin, clear its cache.

Can shoppers see swatches on the shop page?

Yes. The free version shows a preview of one attribute on product cards, and picking a swatch swaps the card image. Turn it on under Shop & Catalog. Pro shows every attribute on the card, with add to cart.

Does it work with my theme?

It works with most WooCommerce themes, including Storefront, Flatsome, Avada, X Theme and Uncode. Some themes need a small CSS tweak; ask in the support forum if yours does.

Does it work in product quick views?

Yes. Swatches also load in the quick view that themes such as Flatsome add to product cards.

Can I hide or cross out options that are out of stock?

Yes, with Pro. It can disable sold-out options and show them crossed out, faded or hidden.

Is it compatible with HPOS and the Cart and Checkout blocks?

Yes. It declares compatibility with WooCommerce order storage (HPOS) and the Cart and Checkout blocks.

What happens to my data if I uninstall the plugin?

Your settings and swatch colors and images stay, so nothing is lost if you reinstall. To remove them, switch on the delete-data option under Woo Swatches > Settings > Advanced before you uninstall.

What is the difference between the free and Pro versions?

The free version gives you color, image, button and radio swatches in 10 styles, style presets, tooltips, plugin product cards and a swatch preview on shop cards. Pro adds full swatches with add to cart on shop cards, card looks, out-of-stock handling, a “+N more” link or slider for long lists, a larger image preview on hover, shareable variation links, per-product settings, extra swatch styles, a shortcode builder, a Gutenberg block, an Elementor widget and priority support. See the Pro features and plans.
